description: This Java class defines a MultiComparisonNode used in representing comparison predicates, particularly for 'IN' comparisons, within an abstract syntax tree in an RQL (Resource Query Language) context. It includes constructors, methods for adding values, and an enum for comparison types.

classes.name: MultiComparisonNode
classes.description: Represents a comparison predicate node in an AST for RQL, supporting multiple comparison types like 'IN', with functionalities to add comparison values and accept visitors.

classes.name: MultiComparisonNode.Type
classes.description: Enumerates the types of multi-value comparison predicates, currently only 'IN'.

methods.name: MultiComparisonNode(final Type comparisonType, final String comparisonProperty)
methods.description: Creates a new MultiComparisonNode with the specified comparison type and property, initializing with an empty list of values.

methods.name: MultiComparisonNode(final Type comparisonType, final String comparisonProperty, final List<Object> comparisonPropertyValues)
methods.description: Creates a new MultiComparisonNode with specified type, property, and initial list of comparison values.

methods.name: addValue(final Object value)
methods.description: Adds a new value to the list of comparison values.

methods.name: accept(final PredicateVisitor predicateVisitor)
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing the PredicateVisitor interface to perform operations on this node.
